headerDisplay: Shelly devices over the local network. Energy meters report per-phase power, voltage, current and energy to OpenBridge, with history charting. Gen2+ relays are exposed as switches you can control from OpenBridge and HomeKit.
footerDisplay: Supported: Shelly 3EM and EM (Gen1), and Gen2+ devices with relay or energy-meter components (Plus/Pro 1/2/4PM, Pro 3EM). Roller-cover mode is not supported yet.

ip.title: IP address
ip.description: IP address or hostname of the Shelly device on your local network.

name.title: Name
name.description: Prefix for the devices this meter creates, e.g. "Home" produces "Home - Total" and "Home - Phase A".

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to read the device. Lower values give finer power resolution at the cost of more network traffic.

showTotal.title: Show combined total
showTotal.description: Register one device summing every phase.

phaseNames.title: Phase names
phaseNames.description: Labels for each phase. Defaults to Phase A, Phase B, Phase C.

exposeToHomeKit.title: Expose to HomeKit
exposeToHomeKit.description: Publish this device to HomeKit. Meter channels appear as a light sensor whose lux value carries watts (HomeKit has no power characteristic); relay channels appear as switches. To show a relay as a light or outlet instead, use the device inspector in OpenBridge — it re-applies the choice on every restart.

alertThreshold.title: Alert threshold (watts)
alertThreshold.description: Adds a HomeKit contact sensor that opens above this power level. 0 disables it.

username.title: Username (optional)
username.description: Only needed if the device has HTTP authentication enabled.

password.title: Password (optional)
password.description: Only needed if the device has HTTP authentication enabled.

switch:0.title: Relay channel 0
switch:0.description: Overrides for the switch:0 channel on a Gen2+ relay. Ignored on Gen1 meters.

exclude.title: Ignore this channel
exclude.description: Do not register this channel as a device at all.
